title: Orchestrated SLA feature (delivery-planner fan-out)
prompt: Use the delivery-planner subagent (via the Task tool) to drive this feature to done by DELEGATING to subagents: it must decompose the work, then spawn the backend-dev subagent to implement, the test-designer subagent to verify the tests, and the code-reviewer subagent to review the diff. Feature: implement SlaPolicy so the pre-written test src/test/java/com/yourorg/golden/request/SlaPolicyTest.java passes (TECHNICAL=4h, BILLING=24h, ACCOUNT=48h, OTHER=72h; dueDate = createdAt plus the window; isBreached is true only strictly after the due date). Do not modify the test. The task is complete only when `./mvnw -o -q -Dtest=SlaPolicyTest test` exits 0.
